Boxing champion Terence Crawford is the guest on episode 174 of the JRE MMA Show with Joe Rogan. Crawford, one of the finest pound-for-pound fighters of his era, moved between weight classes collecting titles. Rogan's MMA show gives combat greats a fighter-to-fighter stage.

Crawford talks training, focus, and the craft behind his calm, ruthless style in the ring. He explains how he reads opponents and switches stance mid-fight. Rogan, a lifelong martial artist, digs into the mental side of the sweet science. Fight fans get a pugilist's wisdom delivered as calmly as he throws a counter.
podcast-tuckercarlson-4v1XdBi0pd0:
Tucker Carlson asks why the Secret Service will not protect Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Kennedy ran for president outside the two main parties. Candidates in his spot, Carlson notes, often got guards in past races.

He recalls that Kennedy's father and uncle were both shot dead. That history, he argues, makes denial of guards cruel. The episode questions who decides which lives get state protection. It frames the choice as political, not routine. Listeners get a pointed case that a famous name and a real threat should have settled the matter at once.
